BiblicalUsage: Jeshanah is a place in Palestine, a town taken by Abijah from Jeroboam. In 2 Chronicles 13:19, Jeshanah with the towns thereof. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: Abijah takes Jeshanah from Jeroboam, and I take this town as a marker of a kingdom split in two.
